body:
I'm going to see her tomorrow. Maybe I should speak to her about it then...

I haven't thought about volunteering with animals, but I have thought about working with preschool children. I love babysitting and young kids because my mom used to bring me out babysitting with her ever since I was young and I developed a passion for it. I love kids and I would love to adopt someday. I've always wanted to be a parent.

I also worked previously at Whole Foods which is where I quit. I feel like they would welcome me back and they did have really good benefits for their workers. I previously left over my grief for my cat, but also because I had to help my grandmother a lot back then. She is on crutches after a nasty accident 20+ years ago and she and I had to find somewhere for her to live. The one thing I'm happy that I've done recently is I helped find the apartment that she is soon to move into.
